results.name: Staff Token Rejected Here (should 401-403)
results.notes: This request deliberately sends a tenant ADMIN token (not a platform/super-admin token) to a platform-only endpoint. 401 Unauthorized is the CORRECT, expected result — it confirms tenant staff tokens are properly rejected from platform routes. Reclassified PASS.

findings.title: 4 of 7 Platform (Super Admin) requests reference an unset token variable
findings.severity: Test-collection defect (unverified whether backend endpoints work)
findings.description: Dashboard, Activity Log, Team List, and Task Create all authenticate via Postman's native 'auth: bearer' field bound to {{json_web_token_0o6s}}. No script anywhere in the collection sets that variable — Platform Login's afterResponse script sets 'platform_token' instead (which List Tenants and Staff Token Rejected Here correctly reference via an Authorization header). As a result these 4 requests send an empty/literal bearer token and get 401. This looks like copy-paste drift when these requests were added to the collection — they were never pointed at the variable Platform Login actually populates. The underlying backend behavior for these 4 endpoints has not been independently verified yet.

evidence.affectedRequests: Dashboard, Activity Log, Team List, Task Create

findings.title: 'Task Create' request is a mislabeled duplicate of 'Team List'
findings.description: Task Create.request.yaml is byte-for-byte identical to Team List.request.yaml: same GET {{server_root}}/platform/team/, same broken auth variable. There is no actual task-creation request in the Platform folder despite the name.
